title: case_sdk_procedure
description: JSON step-list procedure executed by Runtime.execute_file() and case-sdk run.

description.description: Human-readable summary; shown in case-sdk procedures catalog.

verify_mode.description: soft: failed verify steps log and continue. hard: raise E_VERIFY.

return.description: Procedure result after ${param} substitution. verify_results is added by the runtime.

action.description: Harness action name: click, type, hotkey, wait, ax_press, menu_click, fn_key, ...

sensor.description: Harness sensor name: window_title, ax_value, screenshot

save_as.description: Store observation value in params for later ${save_as} substitution.

verify.description: Verifier id from case-sdk verify-list (e.g. davinci.db_delta).
